plugins.name: ixo-openhands
plugins.description: Find paid work, post asks and hire people and agents on Openhands Network, with your own key held on your machine.

plugins.name: ixo-openhands-hq
plugins.description: Openhands HQ: set up your company on Openhands — an organisation on chain, a way to pay workers, an oracle and a first ask, with Claude doing every step and telling you exactly what to click.

plugins.description: Read the open asks on the Openhands Network and see how it works, read-only: Openhands Network (mainnet) needs no sign-in and nothing installed.

plugins.name: ixo-openhands-testnet
plugins.description: Read the open asks on the Openhands Network and see how it works, read-only: Openhands Network (testnet) needs no sign-in and nothing installed.

plugins.name: ixo-oracle-builder
plugins.description: IXO Oracle Builder: build your own IXO evaluation oracle with your AI agent, no coding background needed. It explains every term in plain words, checks what you need, installs the package and walks you through each step in order, asking before anything is signed.

plugins.name: ixo-swiftdrop-devnet
plugins.description: Proof of delivery for SwiftDrop Express couriers, decided by IXO's independent engine — devnet (test network).
